content:
Earlier this week I completed a long-standing project (github.com/mckoen/quasicategory) of mine to formalize "functor quasi-categories"--a generalization of functor categories.

This is essential to the #Infinity-Cosmos (emilyriehl.github.io/infinity-cosmos) project where it will be used to construct the prototypical ∞-cosmos of quasi-categories.

The project involved defining the internal hom of simplicial sets and then proving the internal hom between quasi-categories is a quasi-category (see Kerodon). The main result can be found in https://github.com/mckoen/quasicategory/blob/master/Quasicategory/QCat.lean, where I've used it to show the category of quasi-categories is enriched over itself.

See #Infinity-Cosmos > Functor quasi-categories are formalized.
